notes.title: Growing up’s New FREE DLC is available now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce that Growing Up’s new DLC is available today!
[b]You can get the new DLC content after update to the latest version! Enjoy.[/b]

The new DLC adds 2 new unusual jobs with unique skill trees:

[b]Bowler[/b]

You can now head down to The Alley Way, find the perfect ball, and give bowling a try. Can you become a pro bowler or proud owner of multiple titles?

[b]Magician[/b]

The secret of magic is another mysterious path to follow. Under the wings of equally mysterious and extravagant Daz, you will track down the secrets of magic and illusion to develop your own spectacular magic shows in dazzling theaters.



Besides these two careers, new endings, items, and skills await your discovery!

With the addition of this DLC, you can meet a total of 21 different pals for knowing, loving, and playing! The free DLC brings three new friends to your life:

[b]Jake[/b], a well-meaning but slightly troubled boy that can't help but get into all sorts of trouble.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/52a5993bfe189c0ac2903010b290ddd8a112a1e8.png[/img]

[b]Bobbie[/b], a girl who lives for the spotlight! She’s always busy singing, acting, and performing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/f4653eba08511cde15070278e06aea00abfabdab.png[/img]

[b]Charles[/b], meet “Hoffer”, a boy born into a political family who suffers from the conflicts between his family, identity, and sexual orientation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/8d499b20873c1d0b9faa61b8a80ea735ba5c9533.png[/img]

After hearing your feedback, some amazing community items and the beautiful OST are now available on Steam.

You can see some of the community items here:

https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1191120

The soundtrack includes 30 original songs created by Jim Guthrie, Pat Robitaille, DJ Eprom, Mikromusic, and Paweł Wawrzeńczyk.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1817630/Growing_Up_Original_Soundtrack/

The console and mobile launch dates will be announced soon. We really hope you’ll enjoy our game as you relive the adventure of your childhood days!

If you have any feedback and would like to share with us, please reach us via the following methods:

[list]

[*] [url=https://discord.gg/DUCzWfdZUV]Discord[/url]

[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/Growing-Up-102986898769017]Facebook[/url]

[*] [url=https://twitter.com/GrowingUp_game]Twitter[/url]

[/list]
 
Sincerely,

Vile Monarch

notes.title: [Game Hotfix] - 1.1.3819
notes.content:
Hello there,

Here's today's hotfix.

[h2]Bug fix:[/h2]
- Added the possibility to choose the baby's gender when continuing the game with the next generation
- Added the possibility to choose the partner's gender when ending the game without a romantic relationship with story characters
- Adjusted the character selection system for more characters' variety when starting a New Game
- Added a new dialogue option in Sam's story
- Made more choices lead to romantic relationship with Alex
- Fixed an issue with switched up scenes in Wendy's story
- Slightly redesigned some of the Expectations
- Fixed an exploit with reloading the game during Brain Map to generate a new Brain Map while keeping the amount of Brain Points
- Fixed an issue with T1 and T2 Work Skills not being listed in the Schedule when learning T3 Work Skill first
- Fixed an issue with the Spinner (Brain Map node) spinning very slightly on lower FPS
- Fixed an issue with the Shockwave (Brain Map node) effect going through to the next Brain Map after using the Next Level node
- Fixed an issue with certain Skills being visible on locations' tooltips while the Skills are not yet available for the player to unlock
- Various text, localization, UI and general fixes

If you have any feedback and would like to share with us, please reach us via the following methods:
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/DUCzWfdZUV]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/Growing-Up-102986898769017]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/GrowingUp_game]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: [Game Hotfix] - 1.0.3772
notes.content:
Hello there,

Today's hotfix includes the autosave issue, balancing and many other updates. Have a good weekend everyone!

[h2]Bug fix:[/h2]
- Fixed the issue with progress rollbacks caused by external cloud services, e.g. OneDrive
- Adjusted the 'New Expectation' window to fit the 21:9 aspect ratio
- Fixed a handful of typos in ENG
- Fixed improperly displayed text in one of the tutorial pop-ups in DE
- Renamed the Skill 'Cutting' to 'Papercraft'
- Changed the names and descriptions for a couple of haircuts

[h2]Balance changes:[/h2]
- Raised Mental Health and Parents' Satisfaction stats rebound after getting a Strike
- Lowered penalties for failed Expectations 
- Lowered Mental Health penalties for Exam grades below B
- Lowered Grade Thresholds for Elementary, Middle School and High School Exams
- Lowered the Mental Health penalty for performing Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3 Work Skills
- Reduced prices of certain foods
- Raised Parents' Satisfaction rewards for performing Middle School Skills 
- Some lesser tweaks & adjustments

If you have any feedback and would like to share with us, please reach us via the following methods:
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/DUCzWfdZUV]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/Growing-Up-102986898769017]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/GrowingUp_game]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update: Now the default language follows system language
notes.content:
Hi,

Though Steam Next Fest ended, we still have the demo on the Steam store page. And we want to improve the user experience as much as possible!

Now when new players run the game for the first time, the default language will follow the system language.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/2745294edaaa848462450079f46d888c69f8647a.gif[/img]

If you like the demo, please add GROWING UP to your wishlist and tell your friends how amazing this game is! That means a lot to us!

Thanks very much!
